metadata.scope: Broad representative catalog, NOT exhaustive of global commercial supplements. No product-level dose prescriptions.
metadata.source_policy: Official NIH ODS / NCCIH / FDA / CDC / MedlinePlus prioritization; category-level citations are discovery references, not per-item clinical verification.
metadata.publication_policy: No consumer-specific auto-suggested doses or schedules until evidence and safety content is reviewed and published. Distinguish optional convenience from validated timing.
metadata.clinical_review_required: Yes; this is research-draft content and not a clinical knowledge base or patient-specific advice.

timing_catalog.WITH_FAT_MEAL: With a meal containing some fat (breakfast/lunch are convenience choices, not mandatory)
timing_catalog.WITH_MEAL: With a meal for tolerability or product-specific absorption
timing_catalog.ANY_TIME: Any consistent time; no established universally superior hour
timing_catalog.WITH_WATER: With adequate water; follow label and medication-spacing guidance
timing_catalog.PRE_WORKOUT_OPTIONAL: Before exercise if purpose-specific and tolerated; not a universal need
timing_catalog.POST_WORKOUT_OPTIONAL: After workout if convenient; total daily intake generally matters more
timing_catalog.BEDTIME_OPTIONAL: Evening/near bedtime only if intended for sleep; follow product guidance
timing_catalog.EMPTY_IF_DIRECTED: Empty stomach only when the specific product/clinician instructions call for it; food may improve tolerance
timing_catalog.TIMING_REVIEW: Consult product instructions and clinician/pharmacist; no auto timing
timing_catalog.FOLLOW_LABEL: Follow verified product label; no generic timing rule
timing_catalog.WITH_BREAKFAST_OPTIONAL: With breakfast for convenience, or another meal
timing_catalog.WITH_DINNER_OPTIONAL: With evening meal if convenient, not required

production_catalog.DIET_REQUIRED: The body cannot synthesize adequate quantities; obtain from diet/fortified food, supplement only if needed.
production_catalog.NO_ELEMENT_SYNTHESIS: The body cannot create mineral elements; diet provides them. Supplements are not automatically necessary.
production_catalog.ENDOGENOUS: The body normally produces this compound; supplemental benefit depends on context and is not a universal need.
production_catalog.PARTIAL: The body makes some, but supply/conversion can be limited by diet, physiology or life stage.
production_catalog.PROTEIN_FOOD: Provides amino acids/protein normally available from food. Not a substance the body must synthesize as a supplement.
production_catalog.NONESSENTIAL_PLANT: A plant or herbal preparation, not an essential nutrient; no physiological requirement for the extract.
production_catalog.NONESSENTIAL_OTHER: Not an essential dietary nutrient; the body has no established requirement for the marketed supplement.
production_catalog.MICROBE: Microbes are not nutrients synthesized by human cells; the benefit is strain- and condition-specific.
production_catalog.BLEND: Commercial mixture/formulation, not a distinct physiological nutrient; composition is product-specific.
production_catalog.HORMONE: The body produces this hormone; supplementation is not a sign of an inherent nutrient deficiency.
production_catalog.ESSENTIAL_FAT: Essential fatty acid not made by the body; must come from diet. Other fatty acids may be synthesized to a limited extent.

evidence_catalog.NUTRIENT_ROLE_ESTABLISHED: Essential physiological nutrient role established; supplemental benefit depends on need.
evidence_catalog.CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: Evidence supports some uses in specific populations or contexts, not blanket use.
evidence_catalog.PERFORMANCE_CONTEXT: May support particular athletic outcomes under specific training conditions.
evidence_catalog.LIMITED_MIXED: Human evidence limited, inconsistent, or product-dependent.
evidence_catalog.INSUFFICIENT: Insufficient reliable evidence for routine use or claimed outcomes.
evidence_catalog.HIGH_RISK: Interaction/toxicity/regulatory concern; display for identification only pending clinician review.
evidence_catalog.COMPOSITION: Food/protein/fiber product; effects depend on nutritional contribution/label.
evidence_catalog.MICROBE_STRAIN: Strain- and indication-specific; generic probiotic claims are not validated.
